title: Evacuation of Black Loyalists to Nova Scotia and the Book of Negroes
note: The systematic recording and maritime evacuation of 3,000 Black Loyalists under Sir Guy Carleton to Nova Scotia, leading to Black Nova Scotian communities and the 1792 founding of Freetown, Sierra Leone.

title: Cherokee War of 1776 and frontier defense of Indigenous homelands
note: Cherokee resistance led by Dragging Canoe against encroachment in the Carolinas and Virginia, provoking colonial militia scorched-earth campaigns and the subsequent Chickamauga Wars.

title: Treaty of Fort Stanwix and post-revolutionary dispossession of the Six Nations
note: Dictated peace between the United States and the Haudenosaunee Confederacy following their exclusion from the 1783 Treaty of Paris, forcing large territorial cessions in western New York and Pennsylvania.

title: Migration of Nova Scotian Black Loyalists and the founding of Freetown, Sierra Leone
note: Nearly 1,200 Black Loyalists led by Thomas Peters and David George migrated across the Atlantic from Nova Scotia to West Africa, establishing Freetown as a self-governing settlement of formerly enslaved people.
